## Invitations

A total of 1951 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded at 485, giving an attendance rate of 24.9. The figures provide a summary of the response to the invitation activity and indicate the number of people who attended following an invitation.

The attendance information should be considered alongside the contact arrangements described below. Maintaining a clear record of invitations and attendance supports routine monitoring and provides a consistent basis for reviewing outreach activity.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded SMS figure was 0. No reminder messages were recorded, with the reminder figure also standing at 0.

The contact information has been recorded separately from the invitation and attendance figures so that the use of SMS and reminders can be reviewed clearly. This provides a straightforward account of the communication activity associated with the outreach work.
